subject: TideHealth kickoff: slot selection, attendee roster & draft agenda
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@tidehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: TideHealth kickoff: slot selection, attendee roster & draft agenda

Hi Samantha —

Great to meet you on the call earlier. Per our discussion, we’re ready to lock in a 90-minute kickoff to align teams and confirm the initial implementation roadmap. To make scheduling simple, can you confirm which of these windows works best for your team (all times PDT):

- Tue May 7, 09:00–10:30
- Wed May 8, 13:00–14:30
- Thu May 9, 11:00–12:30

If none of the above fit, feel free to propose two alternatives. Also please confirm the attendee list from TideHealth — we typically see product, engineering, security/compliance, and a project sponsor. Draft Redwood attendees below.

Draft agenda (can iterate):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) High-level implementation plan / milestones (20m)
3) Network, SSO & data flow checklist (20m)
4) Demo of hosting & routing (15m)
5) Roles, immediate next steps, and action owners (25m)

Attachments: redwood_kickoff_template.pdf (one-pager agenda + prework checklist).

Redwood attendees (proposed):
- Karthik Iyer — AE (owner)
- Ben Carter — Implementation Lead
- Marissa Cole — Solutions Engineer

Next steps: pick a time, confirm attendees, and we’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short pre-kickoff checklist.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
https://www.redwoodinference.com

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@tidehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ramirez <c.ramirez@tidehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: TideHealth kickoff: slot selection, attendee roster & draft agenda

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear options. Wed May 8, 13:00–14:30 PDT works for us.

Attendees from TideHealth (confirmed so far):
- Samantha Lee — Sr. PM (owner)
- Carlos Ramirez — Eng Manager (integration lead)
- Priya Malhotra — Security (SSO & compliance) — tentative
- Jordan Li — Data Engineer (will join if slot aligns)

A couple of notes:
- On the network/SSO section, Priya will want to review your SAML metadata and any minimization of logs for PHI. I attached our internal SSO notes (tidehealth_sso_notes.docx) for context.
- Could you add a short slide on rollback/fallback strategy in case we hit a performance regression during pilot? That will help our ops folks.

If you can send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and a link to a shared kickoff doc (Google Drive), we’ll confirm final attendees by EOD Tue May 1.

Samantha
Samantha Lee
Senior Product Manager, TideHealth

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=kickoff
Calendar invite: Sent (look for "TideHealth — Redwood kickoff: May 8 13:00 PDT")
Shared doc (kickoff plan & prework): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Ckickoff-plan

Updated agenda (incorporated rollback slide + callouts):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m) — confirm metrics and pilot scope
2) Implementation roadmap & milestone gating (20m) — Milestone owners and dates
3) Network, SSO & PHI handling (20m) — Priya to lead questions; we’ll share SAML metadata in doc
4) Hosting topology & fallback/rollback approach (15m) — Ben to present fallback options + runbook
5) Next steps, assignees, and immediate actions (25m) — capture into shared doc

Redwood attendees (final):
- Karthik Iyer — AE (host/owner)
- Ben Carter — Implementation Lead (fallback/runbook)
- Marissa Cole — Solutions Engineer (integration & demo)

Prework for TideHealth (requested before kickoff):
- Confirm final attendee list in the shared doc
- Attach SAML metadata and existing proxy/firewall egress rules to the doc
- Add any test data constraints for the pilot (PHI masking requirements)

Attachments: I uploaded the redwood_kickoff_template.pdf and a short rollback overview slide into the Drive folder.

Let us know if you’d like the meeting extended to 2 hours; otherwise we’ll plan for 90 minutes and use the shared doc to track follow-ups.

Thanks — invite should land in your inbox now.

Best,
Karthik
